test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8d9d299473b9767e824ff2e00d7b05401c149aa308308f1d67036f246955ca9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first two elements from the left interchange positions.

The last three elements from the left shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d479b87f72cfd3cf88e3be2792c94928b22918df79dbc83f2c0ce091fc1e3278.png] 

2) Second box series →

The last two elements from the left interchange positions.

The first three elements from the left shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2539dc216f5d8d00d86ec4b4d5fdbe3f7a0d372f7a4cd5940fc4d554b2e0c05a.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/174db0f67715466b3d34b2190dddf7ae0819ce749b4af60a5de2fd8a58efd89c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f8097a15235d48d0eb0284f1d8b9b854519637ef57c82152bb6077487bf3ac0.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
